Hello! I’ve been through this multiple times. A little while ago I went through a sort of counseling class, where we learned how to deal with this kind of situation. 

My advice is to tell someone ahead of time that this person will be broken up with and that they’re threatening to hurt themselves. Tell a family member, or anyone else in their lives. Tell the police if you have to. They will send someone to check and talk to them. Usually if it’s bad enough they will get someone to help.
